requirement: Telemetry payloads use a versioned flattened Avro schema
acceptance_criteria: Schema validates against approved test payloads with zero syntax errors and no ambiguous field types
required_evidence: Version-controlled .avsc file; positive and negative test logs; schema version history

requirement: Policy runtime rejects missing expired revoked or unverified required attestations
acceptance_criteria: All defined invalid/tampered test cases are rejected; test count and coverage reported
required_evidence: Policy tests; fixtures; verifier configuration; test runner output; coverage report

requirement: Payload hashes are independently recomputable from canonical raw transaction records
acceptance_criteria: SHA-256 digest matches expected digest for 1000 controlled test vectors with zero mismatches; canonicalization rules documented
required_evidence: Hash script; canonicalization specification; versioned test vectors; reproducible output

requirement: Thermal protection keeps the designated internal sensor location at or below 70.0 C during the approved thermal profile
acceptance_criteria: Calibrated measurements remain at or below the limit throughout the defined exposure, accounting for instrument uncertainty and agreed pass/fail rule
required_evidence: Approved TP-THERMAL-01; lab report; calibration records; raw time series; specimen description and photos

requirement: Assembly maintains structural integrity and electrical continuity under the approved steady 10G acceleration profile
acceptance_criteria: No defined structural failure; continuity remains within an approved tolerance of baseline; test configuration and measurement uncertainty recorded
required_evidence: Approved TP-MECH-01; lab report; pre/post photos; continuity logs; fixture and axis records

requirement: Consequential state changes freeze when required authorization is absent or invalid
acceptance_criteria: All defined unauthorized high-risk cases enter the specified blocked state; release requires valid authorization and produces an audit event
required_evidence: State-machine specification; test fixtures; policy tests; logs for freeze and authorized recovery

requirement: Each release-gate transition requires an evidence package and recorded human approval
acceptance_criteria: Every gate transition references a manifest, artifact versions/hashes, named reviewer, decision, and timestamp
required_evidence: Evidence manifest; human decision record; commit IDs; signature-verification record where used
